title: 7 Minutes of Terror: The Challenges of Getting to Mars
summary: NASA JPL engineers explain the final minutes of the Curiosity rover's entry, descent and landing on Mars, which combined aerobraking, a parachute and a skycrane. It lays out the tight sequence of events that all had to work automatically.
why: HN repeatedly recommends it as an awe-inspiring example of engineering problem solving and the go-to explainer on how Mars landings work.

quote.text: If you have not watched the seven minutes of terror video produced by NASA, you absolutely must.
